bugs.creator: kevinushey
bugs.summary: setRefClass(): avoidable costs in method processing and object creation; $methods(name = NULL) fails to remove a method

comments.creator: kevinushey
comments.text:
Most of the time setRefClass() takes does not affect its result, and creating a reference class object is dominated by is() calls with a known answer. Also, generator$methods(name = NULL), documented in ?setRefClass as the way to remove a method, does not remove it:

Inc <- setRefClass("Inc", methods = list(m1 = function() 1, m5 = function() 5))
Inc$methods(m5 = NULL)
"m5" %in% Inc$methods()   # TRUE, and Inc$new()$m5() still works; expected FALSE

The attached refclass-bench.R (base R only) times a class with 5 accessor fields and 20 trivial methods plus initialize, a class with 8 typed fields and methods calling each other, object creation, and adding methods one $methods() call at a time. On an arm64 Mac with R-devel r90746, before and after the attached patch:

                                                        r90746    patched
setRefClass, 5 accessor fields, 21 wrapper methods :   6.00 ms    2.12 ms
setRefClass, 8 typed fields, 4 methods             :   3.70 ms    1.88 ms
Typed$new()                                        :  183.0 us    85.0 us
19 x Inc$methods(<one method>)                     :  45.00 ms   14.00 ms

Analysis (src/library/methods/R/refClass.R unless noted, r90746):

1. makeClassMethod() runs codetools::findGlobals() on every method to fill mayCall: 75-90% of its time (85 us for a one-line method, 1.7 ms for 30 lines). The result is intersected with the class's method names, so it is empty when the method mentions none of them, which all.names() tells in microseconds. findGlobals() only reports symbols in the formals or body (or "f<-" for replacement calls), except inside default arguments of nested function definitions, which all.names() does not visit; methods containing a nested function keep the full analysis. .checkFieldsInMethod() walks every body with codetools too, although it can only report assignments to a field name or with <<-. .hasCodeTools() searched the library paths on every call while the answer was FALSE, three times per method without codetools installed.

2. Each method becomes a refMethodDef and each field an activeBindingFunction or defaultBindingFunction via new(); initialize() and validObject() cost 50-130 us per object for slot values known to be valid. The patch constructs them directly for a plain function (or a refMethodDef being re-analysed), identical() to the new() result, attribute order and srcref included; anything else still goes through new().

3. The generator's methods() appends every existing local method for re-analysis so that mayCall can pick up the new names: a full second pass for every call, quadratic for package code adding methods one call at a time. Only methods mentioning a name being defined or removed (or usingMethods()) can change, so only those are appended now. The same line caused the removal bug: the old version of a method being redefined or removed was appended too, so a NULL definition removed the method and insertClassMethods() put it back. Regression test added to tests/reg-tests-1e.R.

4. Object creation runs is() twice per field in .initForEnvRefClass() and twice per method installed by installClassMethod(), plus isVirtualClass() and setdiff() per field. The patch uses inherits() (documented in ?class to use the S4 inheritance for S4 objects), gives isVirtualClass() (RClassUtils.R) one class lookup instead of an is() and two, drops the test for the nonexistent class "externalMethodDef" (always FALSE), and replaces the stopifnot() in is() (is.R), a quarter of its cost, with a plain test; the error message for a non-scalar class2 changes wording.

Proposed patch: attached as refclass-methods-perf.diff, against r90746, applies cleanly to r90748. Apart from the removal fix and the is() message, behaviour is unchanged: mayCall slots and field-assignment warnings compared for nested defaults, replacement methods, usingMethods(), callSuper(), string call heads and local shadowing, with and without codetools; methods' own tests and make check pass.

The patch is also submitted as https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/pull/398, where CI results can be seen.

(This came out of looking at why packages using Rcpp modules, which define one reference class per C++ class at load time, are slow to load: https://github.com/RcppCore/Rcpp/issues/1514.)

comments.creator: kevinushey
comments.text:
Created attachment 3944
standalone timing script (base R only) for the figures in the report

Created attachment 3945
patch v2 against r90751: inherited method restored on removal, slot precedence, virtual-field prototype, tests

Updated patch attached, against r90751; it supersedes attachment 3943, now obsolete. Changes since then, from reviewing the first version:

- Removing an overriding method left the subclass with no method: the superclass's definition is now put back, as if the override had never existed. Removing a merely inherited method still hides it, as before.

- The direct refMethodDef construction let a function's own attributes win over the computed slots (the later of two duplicate names wins in attributes<-); the slots win now, as with new().

- Object creation reads whether a field's class is virtual from the prototype .makeDefaultBinding() already stores, instead of a class lookup per typed field per object.

- The codetools probe is answered once per session and reset when the namespace loads (the old "keep checking" was for the build-time value, when codetools is not installed yet). A codetools added mid-session is seen after a restart.

- reg-tests-1e.R covers the above, plus mayCall being updated when a method an existing method calls is added or removed later.

Two corrections to the report: the table above was measured without codetools; with it, trunk vs. patch on the same machine:

                                                        trunk    patched
setRefClass, 5 accessor fields, 21 wrapper methods :  8.20 ms    2.28 ms
setRefClass, 8 typed fields, 4 methods             :  4.16 ms    2.04 ms
Typed$new()                                        :   179 us      76 us
19 x Inc$methods(<one method>)                     :    53 ms      15 ms

And .hasCodeTools() was called twice per method, not three times. One behaviour change: $methods() no longer re-emits the "local assignment to field name" warnings for methods it does not re-analyse; trunk repeated them on every call.

The methods tests and reg-tests-1e.R pass with and without codetools. Patch also at https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/pull/398.
